description: This file contains Redux selectors for managing and retrieving channel category data in a Mattermost application, including filtering, sorting, and categorizing channels based on various criteria.

methods.name: getAllCategoriesByIds
methods.description: Retrieves all channel categories indexed by their IDs from the global state.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Retrieves a specific channel category by ID from the global state.

methods.name: getCategoryInTeamByType
methods.description: Finds the first category of a specific type within a team.

methods.name: getCategoryInTeamWithChannel
methods.description: Finds the category within a team that contains a specific channel.

methods.name: getCategoryWhere
methods.description: Finds the first category matching a given condition.

methods.name: getCategoryIdsForTeam
methods.description: Returns the list of category IDs for a specific team.

methods.name: makeGetCategoriesForTeam
methods.description: Creates a memoized selector to get categories for a team.

methods.name: makeFilterArchivedChannels
methods.description: Creates a selector to filter out archived channels unless they are currently viewed.

methods.name: makeFilterAutoclosedDMs
methods.description: Creates a selector to auto-close direct message channels based on last viewed time and preferences.

methods.name: makeFilterManuallyClosedDMs
methods.description: Creates a selector to filter out manually closed direct message channels.

methods.name: makeCompareChannels
methods.description: Returns a comparison function for sorting channels alphabetically, prioritizing muted channels last.

methods.name: makeSortChannelsByName
methods.description: Creates a selector to sort channels alphabetically based on display name.

methods.name: makeSortChannelsByNameWithDMs
methods.description: Creates a selector to sort channels alphabetically, including DMs, with display names based on user profiles.

methods.name: makeSortChannelsByRecency
methods.description: Creates a selector to sort channels by recency based on last post or root post.

methods.name: makeSortChannels
methods.description: Returns a sorting function based on category sorting preference (recency or alphabetical).

methods.name: makeGetChannelIdsForCategory
methods.description: Creates a memoized selector to get sorted and filtered channel IDs for a category.

methods.name: makeFilterAndSortChannelsForCategory
methods.description: Creates a selector to filter and sort channels within a category, filtering archived, manually closed, and autoclosed DMs.

methods.name: makeGetChannelsByCategory
methods.description: Creates a selector to get channels grouped by category for a team, with memoization to optimize re-renders.

methods.name: isUnreadChannel
methods.description: Determines if a channel has unread messages based on message counts and last viewed times.
